outcomes.name: The reinforcement approach has been refined based on pilot learnings
The reinforcement approach is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Process & Sustainment to identify what needs to change in the reinforcement approach before scaling.
Refine the reinforcement approach to Process & Sustainment based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined reinforcement approach covering Process & Sustainment ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined reinforcement approach for Process & Sustainment is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the reinforcement approach for Process & Sustainment remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the reinforcement approach affected People Experience & Culture.
Adapt the reinforcement approach relating to People Experience & Culture for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the reinforcement approach covering People Experience & Culture to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor People Experience & Culture among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the reinforcement approach for People Experience & Culture.
